response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a broad technical background, but his experience lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of the role, particularly in C++ on Windows and capital markets/fixed income domains. His profile is more suited to web, mobile, and general software development rather than the specialized financial systems targeted by this position.
strengths: Extensive experience with modern software development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development).
Strong communication skills and knowledge-sharing, as evidenced by workshops and talks.
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages and frameworks.
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience, especially on Windows (last noted in 2015 at National Instruments).
No evident domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking.
Primary experience lies in web/mobile development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than low-latency or financial systems.
